ny.method: Part-year (IT-203): NY resident Jan 1 - Jun 30, 2025 = 181 days; nonresident Jul 1 - Dec 31 = 184 days. Wages allocated 100% to NY for both spouses under the convenience-of-the-employer rule (both employers are NY-based; remote work from FL was at the employees' request, not the employer's necessity - client confirmed 2026-10-25), so resident-period wages are taxable as resident income and nonresident-period wages are NY source income. Alternative day-ratio (181/365) figures: Marcus $33,720.55, Elena $26,778.08 - rejected, see judgment_calls.md.
